title: PrometheusRule (kuberecord subset)
description: Structural contract for the alert rules shipped in deploy/prometheus/. It covers the prometheus-operator PrometheusRule envelope and the Prometheus rule-file grammar inside .spec, restricted to alerting rules — kuberecord ships no recording rules, and a recording rule that appeared here without a deliberate decision would be a mistake, not a feature. Whether the PromQL parses is promtool's job (make verify-observability); this file is about shape.

labels.description: Required because a PrometheusRule with no labels matches no Prometheus: the operator selects rules by label, so an unlabelled rule file installs cleanly and is silently never evaluated.

duration.description: A Prometheus duration: a positive integer and a unit.

alert.description: CamelCase, like the alerts in the upstream kubernetes-mixin, so a fired alert is greppable and reads as a sentence in a notification.

for.description: Required, never omitted. An alert with no `for` fires on a single evaluation, which for every signal here would page on a scrape-length blip.

description.description: Says what is happening, what it costs, and what to look at next. An alert that only restates its own expression is one an on-call engineer has to reverse-engineer at 3am.
